caption: During the 14 day trial a visitor to the store sees only Launching soon. Nobody can browse or buy until you pay for a plan.
The buyer checkout can be tested, but the notice says customers can't purchase until you upgrade. Our $5 test PDF took about 2 minutes and 9 steps to publish.

Yearly billing: Starter $22, Business $59 and Premium $119 a month, plus 21% VAT, for up to $10k, $50k and $200k in sales a year. The app shows no 2% fee above that cap, which the public FAQ mentions.
Starter on monthly billing at checkout: $29.00 plus $6.09 VAT, $35.09 due now, and the line Upgrading will end your free trial. We entered nothing. The first name field is hidden.
To test a real purchase you first connect Stripe or PayPal; both were off in our trial. Letting customers pay still needs an upgrade on top of that.
